reinstall_trigger.description: Changing this to any value other than "none" performs an OS reinstall, which DESTROYS ALL DATA on disk. A reinstall is required to apply changes to operating_system, layout or ssh_key_fingerprints; changing one of those without also changing reinstall_trigger fails the plan.
